releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.MongoDBOASIS v2.0.5

Connects the OASIS to MongoDB -- the world's leading NoSQL document database with flexible schema, rich querying, horizontal sharding, and Atlas cloud hosting. The recommended default persistence backend for self-hosted OASIS ONODE deployments. Stores all OASIS holons, avatars, karma records, and key-value data as BSON documents. Part of the OASIS HOT-Swappable Provider Architecture. Ecosystem: https://oasisomniverse.one
